description: This file provides extension methods for converting units between MigraDoc's Unit and XUnit/XUnitPt types used in rendering, handling various unit types such as points, centimeters, inches, and millimeters.

classes.name: UnitConversions
classes.description: Provides static extension methods for converting between different measurement units used in MigraDoc rendering.

methods.name: ToXUnit
methods.description: Converts a Unit object to an XUnit, attempting to match the UnitType to an appropriate XGraphicsUnit.

methods.name: TryGetAsXGraphicsUnit
methods.description: Tries to map a UnitType (Point, Centimeter, Inch, Millimeter) to a corresponding XGraphicsUnit; Pica is not supported.

methods.name: ToUnit
methods.description: Converts an XUnit to a Unit, trying to match its type to a UnitType; defaults to points if no direct match.

methods.name: TryGetAsUnitType
methods.description: Tries to map an XGraphicsUnit to a corresponding UnitType; Presentation is not supported.

methods.name: ToXUnitPt
methods.description: Converts a Unit to an XUnitPt based on its point measurement.

methods.name: ToUnit
methods.description: Converts an XUnitPt to a Unit based on its point measurement.
